intro: Mali has about 24 million people, one of the youngest populations in the world.

chapters.title: People
text: The Bambara are the largest group, and Bambara is widely spoken. Others include the Fula, Soninke, Songhai, Dogon and Tuareg. Most people are Muslim.
Griots have passed down history through songs and stories for centuries.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Bamako, on the Niger, is one of Africa's fastest-growing cities.

keyTerms.meaning: Mali's largest group and main language.
